description: This file contains the implementation of advanced operations for the Web Module Container Object, including enrolling, manufacturing, and destroying feature objects such as the Web Simple Server Object and related components.

classes.name: PWEB_MODULE_CONTAINER_OBJECT
classes.description: Pointer to the Web Module Container Object, managing web server components and their lifecycle.

classes.name: PANSC_OBJECT_MAPPER_OBJECT
classes.description: Object used to register and manage feature objects within the container.

classes.name: PHTTP_HELPER_CONTAINER_OBJECT
classes.description: Helper container for HTTP-related functionalities used by the web module.

classes.name: PWEB_SIMPLE_SERVER_OBJECT
classes.description: Represents the simple web server object managed within the module container.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebMcoEnrollFeatureObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls default feature objects into the container, making them externally visible and usable.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebMcoManufactureFeatureObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Creates and initializes internal feature objects such as the helper container and the simple server.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebMcoDestroyFeatureObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Removes and cleans up feature objects during shutdown or reset of the module container.
